component.name: HybridSliceCraft
component.summary: Slicer for filament (FDM) and resin (MSLA) 3D printers

description.p: HybridSliceCraft prepares models for both kinds of 3D printer in one program: filament printers (FDM) and resin printers (MSLA).

ul.li: Slices to G-code and sends it to OctoPrint or Moonraker
Supports, infill patterns and calibration prints
Saves files for Elegoo (GOO), Anycubic (Photon Workshop), Chitu (CTB) and SL1 printers
Hollowing with drain holes, automatic supports with a raft, and a list of floating parts
Smoother sloped surfaces with Z anti-aliasing

description.p: Also: repair, cut, mirror, copy and auto-orient models, several plates, undo and redo, a light and a dark theme, English, German, French and Spanish, and shortcuts you can change.
A manual with pictures, examples and hints for every feature, and the program's code tidied up.
Mixed filaments: colours made by alternating filaments layer by layer, made from a ratio, a pattern or a colour match, and painted on a model like any filament.
Opens STEP files. Text can be pasted into the program, and Windows no longer shows an extra command window.

Paint support enforcers, blockers, seams and fuzzy skin; import your own presets; scarf seam, mouse ears, new infill patterns, height ranges, flush volumes, no-go areas, and sending to PrusaLink and Duet printers.
Separate filaments for top and bottom surfaces, pause or filament change at a layer, machine limits, acceleration, flow and fan for each kind of line, more Z-hop types and overhang speed steps.
Every kind of line now follows the nozzle of the tool that prints it, so different nozzle sizes work for walls, infill and support.
Choose a different filament for inner walls, solid infill, support and support interface.
Much faster filament slicing of models with many separate parts per layer, and faster automatic supports.
About twice as fast slicing for filament printers, plus a benchmark mode for it.
Much faster resin slicing, with the same results and less memory, plus a benchmark mode.
Fixes Auto-orient for filament printing, which could leave a model needing much more support.
Paint a model with several filaments, and presets for the Snapmaker U1.
More filament print options: four infill patterns, brim, fuzzy skin and ironing choices, wall order, input shaper, object labels and two new calibration prints.
Adds saving for Anycubic printers and a list of Elegoo and Anycubic machines.

Adds GOO export for Elegoo, support strength presets, a vented raft, orient scoring for resin, a list of floating parts, Z anti-aliasing, a light theme, German, French and Spanish, and editable shortcuts.
